job_description:
BasisPath is seeking a Lead Software Engineer to support the development of mission-critical capabilities. In this role, you will be responsible for architecting and developing software solutions, leveraging modern cloud-based environments and DevSecOps technologies. As a lead engineer, you will help transform existing software into cloud-native applications, improving deployment processes and enhancing release frequency.

About BasisPath:

BasisPath, a rapidly growing woman and veteran-owned small business, is actively seeking talented candidates to support our expanding business commitments. We offer a comprehensive benefits package, including signing bonuses, relocation assistance, expense reimbursement, 100% paid health insurance, competitive compensation, growth opportunities, profit sharing, relevant training, and generous PTO.

At BasisPath, we prioritize our employees' well-being and professional development. Join us and become part of our dedicated team!

Responsibilities:

• Lead software development efforts for application modernization projects.

• Utilize cloud-based and DevSecOps technologies to enhance software capabilities.

• Work on migrating and modernizing enterprise applications into cloud environments.

• Collaborate with cross-functional teams to deliver high-quality software solutions.

• Participate in the modernization of technology stacks and deployment strategies.

Required Qualifications:

• Self-motivated individual with excellent communication skills.

• Expertise in Microsoft platform technologies and modern programming languages.

• Experience in cloud-based or service-oriented software development environments.

• Hands-on experience with relational and non-relational database systems.

• Familiarity with web protocols, AWS architectures, and DevSecOps practices.

• Understanding of software development and sustainment best practices.

• Active Top Secret Security Clearance with the ability to obtain SCI post-hire.

• U.S. Citizenship is required.

• Typically requires a bachelor's degree in a related field and significant relevant experience.

Desired Qualifications:

• Experience with CI/CD tools and practices.

• AWS certifications.

• Knowledge of geospatial technologies or related fields.

If you are passionate about cloud-based software development and want to be part of a team that makes a difference, we would love to hear from you.
